INSERT INTO system_cache (
                region_id,
                constellation_id,
                system_id,

                region_name,
                constellation_name,
                system_name,

                security,
                security_str
            )
            SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
                $1::INTEGER[],
                $2::INTEGER[],
                $3::INTEGER[],

                $4::VARCHAR[],
                $5::VARCHAR[],
                $6::VARCHAR[],

                $7::REAL[],
                $8::VARCHAR[]
            )
